versions.changelog: v2.4.6: OFD parser 4 bug fixes (buyer name/tax id/seller detect/tax amount) + five-format regression tests (65 passed)

v2.4.4 introduces stability improvements and expands documentation.

- Marked as a stable release; validated on 48 real invoices.
- New documentation files added: LICENSE, README.md, RELEASE_NOTES.md.
- Modularized core code—separate configuration (`config.py`) and compatibility (`invoice_extractor_v240_compat.py`) scripts added.
- Removed/cleaned legacy scripts, unified documentation structure.
- Skill usage and features clarified in the updated SKILL.md.
v2.4.1: 修复 ClawHub 显示名（从 V2.4.0 改为发票提取统计系统，仅元数据更新）
火车票字段重写：购方/税号/价税合计/9%6%税率/起终点车次
集成 PP-StructureV3（表格识别 + 版面分析）；支持复杂版面纯图片发票
集成 PaddleOCR 3.7（针对纯图片发票场景）；火车票字段抽取升级；智能 fallback
v2.0.0: 修复通行费「合 计」跨行 bug（税额从 ¥0 修正到正确值）；增量升级 v2~v8 全部改进（康熙字典/水印兜底/多税率留空/布局感知/命令行参数）；修复 SKILL.md slug bug；修复 _meta.json author bug

- Removed the file skill-card.md from the project.
- No feature or functional changes; documentation file cleanup only.

Initial release with core features:

- Extracts data from VAT electronic invoices and railway e-tickets (train tickets) in PDF format.
- Outputs formatted Excel files with key fields such as invoice number, date, buyer, seller, tax rate, and totals.
- Runs fully locally with Python and pdfplumber, no external APIs required.
- Supports special cases: mixed tax rates, tax-exempt/non-taxed invoices, and watermarked PDFs.
- Automatically recognizes and handles train tickets, filling fields accordingly.
